tools.name: retently_ping
tools.description: Show the authenticated Retently account: identity, current plan, survey credit balance for the period, and usage counters (contacts, feedback, outbox, queue, suppressions). Good first call to check the key works.

tools.name: retently_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (contacts) with paging, sorting, date range and property filters. Use email to find one customer. Pass attributes such as country equal US.

tools.name: retently_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its Retently customer ID, with its properties and tags.

tools.name: retently_list_companies
tools.description: List companies with industry, tags, NPS, CSAT or CES metrics and customer counts. Use sort=-companyName for descending names.

tools.name: retently_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by its Retently company ID or by its domain (for example acme.com).

tools.name: retently_list_feedback
tools.description: List customer survey responses (feedback) with filters by customer email or ID, campaign, date range and customer properties. Each item has the score and comment.

tools.name: retently_get_feedback
tools.description: Get one survey response by its feedback ID, with its score, comment, topics and tags.

tools.name: retently_list_outbox
tools.description: List sent surveys (outbox) with delivery status and recipient. Filter by email, campaign, channel (email or in-app), sender type, and date range.

tools.name: retently_get_score
tools.description: Get the latest score, rating distribution and response count for one metric (nps, csat, ces, star, thumbs, xsat or pmf). Each customer's latest response in the period counts, except xsat.

tools.name: retently_get_reports
tools.description: Get reports for all survey campaigns or one campaign: trend data, delivery stats and rating question stats. startDate and endDate are YYYY-MM-DD in the account timezone.

tools.name: retently_list_trend_groups
tools.description: List trend groups with their metric type, default status and creation date. Use a group ID with retently_get_trends.

tools.name: retently_get_trends
tools.description: Get the trends of one trend group: current vs baseline scores with deltas, trend lines and respondent distributions. date is a range keyword such as past-week.

tools.name: retently_list_templates
tools.description: List survey templates with their names, channels and metrics.

tools.name: retently_get_template
tools.description: Get one survey template by ID, including all its survey questions.

tools.name: retently_list_campaigns
tools.description: List survey campaigns with name, metric type, channel, template and status (active or deactivated).

tools.name: retently_list_suppressed_emails
tools.description: List the email addresses on the suppression list. Suppressed emails never receive surveys.

tools.name: retently_list_suppressed_domains
tools.description: List the domain patterns on the suppression list. Emails matching a pattern never receive surveys.

tools.name: retently_upsert_customers
tools.description: Create or update up to 1,000 customers in one call, with names, company, tags and properties. Needs an API key with Write permission. Repeating the same call gives the same result.

tools.name: retently_unsubscribe_customers
tools.description: Stop future surveys for up to 100 customers, by email address. Needs an API key with Write permission. Repeating the same call gives the same result.

tools.name: retently_send_survey
tools.description: Queue a survey through a campaign for up to 100 customers. This emails real people. Confirm the recipients first. Only send to customers who gave permission (no purchased or scraped lists). Needs a Write key.

tools.name: retently_add_suppressed_email
tools.description: Add one email address to the suppression list, so it never receives surveys. Needs a Write key. Repeating the call gives the same result.

tools.name: retently_add_suppressed_domain
tools.description: Add a domain pattern to the suppression list, so emails matching it never receive surveys. Wildcards allowed, e.g. *.example.com. Needs a Write key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: retently_list_customers, retently_list_feedback, retently_get_feedback, retently_list_outbox, retently_list_suppressed_emails, retently_list_suppressed_domains, retently_add_suppressed_email, retently_add_suppressed_domain · Private data: retently_ping, retently_list_customers, retently_upsert_customers, retently_unsubscribe_customers · Public sink: retently_list_customers, retently_list_feedback, retently_list_outbox, retently_list_suppressed_emails, retently_unsubscribe_customers, retently_send_survey, retently_add_suppressed_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: retently_list_customers, retently_list_feedback, retently_get_feedback, retently_list_outbox, retently_list_suppressed_emails, retently_list_suppressed_domains, retently_add_suppressed_email, retently_add_suppressed_domain · Private data: retently_ping, retently_list_customers, retently_upsert_customers, retently_unsubscribe_customers · Public sink: retently_list_customers, retently_list_feedback, retently_list_outbox, retently_list_suppressed_emails, retently_unsubscribe_customers, retently_send_survey, retently_add_suppressed_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
